name: interrogate
description: Checks Python code for docstring coverage with badge generation and reporting

install_steps: For PNG badge generation: pip install interrogate[png]
install_guidance.note: Available via pip/pipx. Source: https://github.com/econchick/interrogate (600+ stars). Written in Python. Requires Python >=3.7.

commands.description: Measure docstring coverage of Python files in specified paths

args.name: paths
args.description: Paths to Python files/directories (default: current directory)

args.name: fail-under
args.description: Fail when coverage % is less than a given amount (default: 80.0)

args.name: verbose
args.description: Level of verbosity

args.name: quiet
args.description: Do not print output, only return exit code

args.name: output
args.description: Write output to a given FILE

args.name: config
args.description: Read configuration from pyproject.toml or setup.cfg

args.name: exclude
args.description: Exclude paths of files and/or directories

args.name: ignore-init-method
args.description: Ignore __init__ method of classes

args.name: ignore-init-module
args.description: Ignore __init__.py modules

args.name: ignore-magic
args.description: Ignore magic methods of classes

args.name: ignore-module
args.description: Ignore module-level docstrings

args.name: ignore-private
args.description: Ignore private classes/methods/functions

args.name: ignore-semiprivate
args.description: Ignore semiprivate classes/methods/functions

args.name: ignore-nested-functions
args.description: Ignore nested functions and methods

args.name: ignore-nested-classes
args.description: Ignore nested classes

args.name: ignore-regex
args.description: Regex identifying names to ignore

args.name: whitelist-regex
args.description: Regex identifying names to include

args.name: style
args.description: Style of docstrings: sphinx or google (default: sphinx)

args.name: omit-covered-files
args.description: Omit files with 100% coverage

args.name: no-color
args.description: Disable color output

commands.description: Generate a shields.io status badge (SVG image) for docstring coverage

args.name: path
args.description: File or directory path for the generated badge

args.name: paths
args.description: Paths to Python files/directories to analyze

args.name: badge-format
args.description: Badge format: svg or png (default: svg)

args.name: badge-style
args.description: Badge style: flat, flat-square, for-the-badge, plastic, social

args.name: fail-under
args.description: Fail when coverage % is less than a given amount

args.name: exclude
args.description: Exclude paths of files and/or directories
